text:
incident-bot: [P1] dedpool-asterion-gpu-3 reporting repeated PCIe/DMA errs then node preempted by host. Node automatically marked DRAINING and tenants moved. Pager sent to oncall-sre-mike. https://redwood.inc/ops/alerts/4112345678
oncall-sre-mike: I'm on it, joining bridge. tagging @priya for infra hot-spare plan.
priya-eng-infra: I see node offline, IO errors in BMC logs. hot-spare pool has 2 available nodes in same AZ but not pinned to Asterion. Can we failover there?
nina-runtime: We have active sessions for asterion-health pinned to nv-s4 models, KV cache warm. Failing over will drop caches; expect ~1.2s p99 spike and some token throttles.
jason-support: Heads up to Asterion CS — currently ~40 in-flight requests timed out, we have 6 errors surfaced to customer console.
emma-cs: Notified Asterion success team, they're asking for ETA and whether we can preserve session continuity. They want a brief note for their SREs.
priya-eng-infra: Plan: (1) mark node quarantined, (2) promote hot-spare -> dedpool with immediate capacity bloat, (3) route new requests to spare and leave in-flight to drain (30s TTL). Executing now.
priya-eng-infra: run: ```redwoodctl node quarantine dedpool-asterion-gpu-3 && redwoodctl pool promote-hotspare dedpool-asterion --count 1```
oncall-sre-mike: Executed promote. Routing update pushed, BGP/route sync shows 1 extra instance in pool.
nina-runtime: Routing OK, but model shard placement lagging. KVCACHE misses rising to ~85%. I'm triggering a fast warm of critical prefixes for asterion: ```redwoodctl cache prewarm --tenant asterion-health --prefixes 10```
hardware-ops: We pulled ECC dump, found sustained parity flips on GPU DIMM0 and PCIe link flapping. Will coordinate RMA. Not a graceful preempt; looks like hardware degraded then host preempted.
jason-support: Customer seeing recovery, error rate falling back to baseline. They still reported a resumed couple 500s after failover; collecting logs.
emma-cs: Asterion requests 2h warm spares and an SLA note about root cause. @richard-acct can you confirm commercial response?
richard-acct: OK, we can approve 2h of reserved hot-spare at no charge as goodwill. I'll prepare a short incident blurb and credit proposal.
oncall-sre-mike: Handoff: I'm toggling incident to monitoring mode. Hardware-ops to RMA and followup. Priya, confirm node replacement ETA?
priya-eng-infra: RMA ticket created #RMA-2026-4129, vendor ETA 6 hours. We'll keep hot-spare for 8 hours to be safe, then scale back.
nina-runtime: Post-mitigation TODOs: (a) run full KV replay for asterion prefixes, (b) run a regression check on latency. Scheduling now.
hardware-ops: Will attach ECC dumps to RMA and schedule physical swap. Leaving node isolated.
incident-bot: Incident updated -> status: mitigated (traffic redirected to hot-spare). severity->monitoring. responders: oncall-sre-mike, priya-eng-infra, hardware-ops.
oncall-sre-mike: Closing the active page. If anything regresses -> re-open. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
